sloka: नूनं लङ्का हते पापे रावणे राक्षसाधमे ।शोषं यास्यति दुर्धर्षा प्रमदा विधवा यथा ।। ५.२६.२९।।।।
transliteration: nūnaṁ laṅkā hate pāpe rāvaṇe rākṣasādhame ।śoṣaṁ yāsyati durdharṣā pramadā vidhavā yathā ।। 5.26.29।।।।

translations.english: "Surely this impregnable Lanka will wither up (lose its splendour) and appear like a widow when this sinful Ravana, a mean demon is killed.
